author: Brandy Betz
title: Apple makes first tax payment to Ireland - Apple Inc. AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) pays $1.18B into an escrow account, its first tranche of disputed taxes to Ireland.
The EU previously decided Ireland gave Apple unfair tax benefits, said Apple needed to repay the money, and threatened Ireland with legal action if it didn’t collect.
Apple needs to pay $16B total into the account, which was set up because Ireland didn’t want the liability if the money lost value while Apple appeals the EU decision.
